== Documentation ==
The documentation comments for this script come from the <code>DefaultActivateSelf.psc</code> source file.

<source>
Activates itself when THIS object's OnTriggerEnter event fires.
<RefToCheck> is the reference triggering THIS Object.
<LocationToCheck> is the current location of THIS object.
</source>
